name: Ninurta
subtitle: Keeper of Sharur
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Ninurta, son of Enlil, is a god of both war and agriculture, violence and healing. Beloved by the people of Ekur, he behaves more as hero than as god, slaying demons and protecting his worshipers from threats both monstrous and mundane. In a pantheon devoted largely to the cycles of nature, he cares more for his people than for cosmic balance.
